Maria (CSM): Quick heads-up — Crescent added 3 new squads today (Search, Agents, Knowledge). Embeddings qps up ~4x over last 12h. Renewal lands in ~6w. Putting on our radar for expansion + renewal-watch. cc @Jason @Annie :eyes:
Jason (AE): Thanks — do we know which endpoints are spiking? embeddings or chat gen?
Maria (CSM): Mainly embeddings and a bunch of small batch async jobs hitting /v1/embeddings. Also a few realtime calls to the search endpoint for UI previews.
Annie (SE): Got it. Can you share a sample request size? window length, batch sizes, any large docs?
Maria (CSM): Most batches ~2500 tokens, avg vector dim 1536. A subset of requests include multi-doc concat (~10 docs) hitting the summarizer before embed.
Leo (Platform Eng): @Maria I pulled their quota metrics — quota-bot report attached. Currently on hosted tier with 1,000 qps soft cap; they're at ~750 sustained with 4x bursts. Risk of throttling if ramp continues.
quota-bot: Crescent org (org_8732): current qps 760, 1h p95 latency 120ms, embeddings tokens 420k last 24h, cost anomaly +28% week-over-week.
Ryan (Customer Success Manager): Renewal risk flagged — they mentioned cost surprise in last check-in. We should propose a dedicated pilot or committed tier to stabilize unit cost.
Jason (AE): Agreed. I'll draft a Dedicated pilot proposal: 4x GPUs reserved, 3-month intro, pricing + 20% commit discount? Thoughts @Ryan @Maria
Maria (CSM): Discount is fine but let's bundle an enablement workshop and a prompt/ops audit. They asked about hallucinations in summarization when doc >8k tokens. We should collect repro prompts.
Annie (SE): I'll schedule a deep-dive workshop. Proposed agenda: 30m infra (routing, batching), 45m prompt/engineering, 30m evals & rollout playbook. When is Crescent available?
Maria (CSM): They said Thurs/Fri next week afternoons PT. I'll confirm availability and send calendar.
Leo (Platform Eng): For the Dedicated pilot: we can carve a small private pool and enable prefix-KV caching + optimized kernel set. Need an engineering request to provision; ETA ~48h after approval.
Annie (SE): Also need sample failing summaries and a short eval set (10 prompts) to baseline quality before we change quantization or batching. Can Crescent send that?
Maria (CSM): I'll ask them to upload evals to the support ticket and to drop a few failing examples in this channel.
Ryan (Customer Success Manager): For renewal negotiation: propose 3-month committed pilot with a renewal credit structure if performance/latency SLOs met. That reduces perceived risk and keeps them engaged.
Jason (AE): I'll include that in the commercial draft. Also ask legal about an SLA addendum for the pilot.
Leo (Platform Eng): Flag: if they enable large prefix caching we need to monitor KV memory pressure — might need node resizing. I can set an alert and an automatic autoscale plan.
Maria (CSM): Action items: 1) I confirm workshop timing (Maria). 2) Jason drafts pilot + renewal credit (Jason). 3) Annie collects eval prompts & runs baseline (Annie). 4) Leo prepares provisioning checklist & alerts (Leo). 5) Ryan owners renewal play (Ryan).
Ryan (Customer Success Manager): Noted. Also capturing feedback: they want clearer cost visibility per-squad and per-route. Can we add a per-route cost export for them before workshop?
Leo (Platform Eng): We can generate a CSV export from Console analytics for last 30d. I'll attach it to the ticket.
Maria (CSM): Crescent asked for a single POC who coordinates infra + finance decisions. @Jason can you confirm POC on their side?
Jason (AE): I spoke to their product lead, Sara. She's the POC for infra and finance. I'll intro on the invite.
Annie (SE): One more note — when we run the workshop, let's show them quantization tradeoffs for embeddings vs generation. Short demo with numbers wins.
Maria (CSM): Agreed. Ok team — I'll send the invite once Crescent confirms Thurs 2pm PT. I'll also ask them to drop 8-10 failing summaries and 10 eval prompts in the support ticket. Thanks :rocket:
